quote_json: "any in, out, or ref parameters, or an parameter of a ref struct type."
notes: csc accepts an iterator method with an unused ref struct parameter without any diagnostic at C# 7.3 and every probed later version through latest. 15.14.1 (printed p. 460) forbids a ref struct parameter without an exception for unused parameters. No later conforming version was found.

quote_json: "A task type can have at most one type parameter and cannot be nested in a generic type."
notes: csc accepts an async method returning a nongeneric task class nested in a generic type, with a complete nongeneric builder, without diagnostics at C# 7.3 and every probed later version through latest. 15.15.1 (printed p. 464) excludes such a nested type from task types, so it is not a permitted async return type. No later conforming version was found.

quote_json: "stateMachine will call builder.SetStateMachine(stateMachine) on the builder instance associated with stateMachine."
notes: The task completes, but csc's default unoptimized state machine does not forward the builder's explicit stateMachine.SetStateMachine(stateMachine) call to the associated builder at C# 7.3 or any probed later version through latest. 15.15.2 (printed p. 466) requires that forwarding when the builder makes the call. With /optimize+ at C# 7.3, the same source conforms and its construct mutant fails.

quote_json: "A static class shall not include a class_base specification"
notes: csc accepts static class Gauge : object without diagnostics at C# 7.3 and latest. 15.2.2.4.1 (printed p. 359) prohibits a class_base specification on a static class. Removing the base clause compiles; neither tested language mode conforms on the original.

quote_json: "An external method shall not be generic."
notes: csc accepts a generic extern method carrying [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.InternalCall)] without any diagnostic at C# 7.3 and every probed later version through latest. 15.6.8 (printed p. 412) forbids generic external methods; clause 5 (printed p. 9) requires a diagnostic, represented here by the suite's reject kind. No later conforming version was found. Calling the method produces TypeLoadException.
